caseName: International Union of Mine, Mill & Smelter Workers v. Eagle-Picher Mining & Smelting Co.
caseNameFull: International Union of Mine, Mill & Smelter Workers v. Eagle-Picher Mining & Smelting Co.
attorneys: Mr. Louis N. Wolf for petitioners. Messrs. A. C. Wallace, H. W. Blair, John G. Madden, James E. Burke, and Ralph M. Russell for the Eagle-Picher Mining & Smelting Co. et al., respondents., Solicitor General Fahy, Mr. Alvin J. Rockwell, and Miss Ruth Weyand filed a memorandum on behalf of the National Labor Relations Board, respondent, and Mr. Lee Pressman filed a brief on behalf of the Congress of Industrial Organizations, as amicus curiae, urging issuance of the writ.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted.
